comment: R-em3d24-4a. The SDK archive rather than the .dmg: it unpacks with no disk image to mount. Its build links OpenCASCADE 7.8.1 where F0's Homebrew Gmsh linked 7.9.3; the version circuitRF checks is Gmsh's own.
layoutNote: Upstream's binary archive: the program finds its libraries relative to itself, so the home is built in .partial and renamed into place.

sources.checksumNote: gmsh.info publishes no checksum for its binary archives, so this download is not verified against one

measured.source: circuitRF archive trial, macOS 27.0 on an Apple M4, 2026-09-25: 36 MB download in 20 s, 94 MB unpacked; 'gmsh --version' printed 4.15.2 (R-em3d24-4a)
